findings: `dsh plugin --help` ALSO requires `--profile` (it is a pnpm forwarder), so the documented uninstall failed for the same reason as any other call: measured `error: required option '--profile <name>' not specified`.

In the `dsh-tui` profile our patch logs `dsh: [@mpd-dsh/mpd] patch: entry "agent-presets" not found` at dump-config time, yet the composition still composes and the preset default IS `mpd` (measured two lines later). Worth a look: our bundle patch's `agent-presets` row is id-targeted, and that id does not exist in the TUI layer stack (it is inserted instead).

`dsh plugin ... add/remove` reconciles `dsh.profile.bundles` only when pnpm EXITS 0: a killed run leaves the manifest half-updated (observed once: the dependency removed while the bundle entry stayed).
notClaimed: No browser or TTY session was driven: the TUI boot refusal is measured, but the TUI's rendered screens are not (tui-panels owns that).
The install/remove measurements ran against sandbox profile copies with a redirected, writable pnpm store; the commands themselves are the user-facing ones, unchanged.
